decisions.reason: A black-finish variant of the existing drainage range sits squarely within the firm's design and surface know-how, so the firm can read early demand easily, though it is only mentioned on the website and stays a little exposed to trend shifts.

A shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on the firm's core channel expertise and its push toward barrier-free bathrooms, and it has its own page, so it is a strategic fit the firm can refine through its own R&D.

Pump-assisted drainage adds mechanical and electrical components that are further from the firm's metal-drain knowledge, making early results harder to interpret, but it serves renovation niches and its own R&D can close the gaps, so the firm keeps it for now.
A tileable floor drain with grating is a close extension of established products with a dedicated page, so the firm can learn from installer feedback and improve it with little risk.
A stainless steel design grate uses the firm's core fabrication and design skills, has a dedicated page, and fits its design-led positioning.
